gloss: back side; reverse side; hidden aspect

definitions.gloss: back side; reverse side; back surface
definitions.explanation: The back or reverse surface of a physical object such as paper, a card, fabric, or a sign.

definitions.gloss: hidden side; behind the scenes; hidden aspect
definitions.explanation: The unseen or concealed aspect of a situation, person, or event. The side that is not publicly known.

examples.japanese: {裏面|りめん}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name on the back.

examples.japanese: カードの{裏面|りめん}に{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}が{印刷|いんさつ}されている。
examples.english: Precautions are printed on the back of the card.

examples.japanese: {封筒|ふうとう}の{裏面|りめん}に{差出人|さしだしにん}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}くのがマナーだ。
examples.english: It's good manners to write the sender's address on the back of the envelope.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{裏面|りめん}を{探|さぐ}る。
examples.english: To investigate the hidden side of the incident.

examples.japanese: {華|はな}やかな{成功|せいこう}の{裏面|りめん}には{多|おお}くの{苦労|くろう}がある。
examples.english: Behind the glamorous success, there is a lot of hardship.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}の{裏面|りめん}を{描|えが}いたドキュメンタリーが{話題|わだい}になっている。
examples.english: A documentary depicting the behind-the-scenes of politics has become a talking point.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (physical back side) is the more common everyday usage. Sense 2 (hidden aspect) is used in more formal or literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏面|りめん}に{記載|きさい} (written on the reverse side)
- {裏面|りめん}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check the back side)
- {事件|じけん}の{裏面|りめん} (the hidden side of an incident)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏|うら}: back; reverse — more colloquial and versatile
- {背面|はいめん}: back side; rear — more technical, often used for the back of electronic devices or buildings
- {表面|ひょうめん}: surface; front side — the opposite of {裏面|りめん}
